    g,b=cal[a['lab_id']].T

    return a['strain_0'][:,None]+amp@(-np.expm1(-t[None,:]/q[:,None]))+drift[:,None]*t,amp@(1/q)+drift
curve,rate=recurrence(te,xte)

for groups in (l,l//2):
